### Fixed
- **`muster auth login` no longer waits for a callback another process received.** The OAuth callback listened on `127.0.0.1:3000` only, while the browser resolves the redirect's `localhost` to `::1` first: a local dev server on `[::1]:3000` received the callback and the CLI waited for its full timeout, saying nothing. The callback now listens on the port on `127.0.0.1` and `::1` (127.0.0.1 alone on a host without IPv6 loopback), and a port held on either address stops the login at once with `callback port <port> is already in use on <address> by:` and the holder's socket, pid and command line. `muster auth login --callback-port` sets the port, as `MUSTER_OAUTH_CALLBACK_PORT` does. ([#1280](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1280))
